title: Write Better Prompts in 30 Seconds
description: The 4-part prompt formula (context, task, example, format) plus one pro tip that changes every answer. Follow for a new AI lesson every day. Not affiliated with Anthropic. #ai #claude #learnai #aitips #shorts

scenes.narration: Vague prompts get vague answers. Here's how to fix that.
Vague questions get vague answers. Compare: write a workout plan. With: I'm a beginner with twenty minutes a day and no equipment, make me a one-week plan as a table.

visual.title: Vague vs *specific*
items: Specific: Beginner, 20 min a day, no equipment, as a table

scenes.narration: Use four parts. Context: who you are and why. Task: what you want. Example: what good looks like. And format: a list, a table, or an email.
Here's that in action. I run a small bakery. Write three friendly Instagram captions for our new cinnamon rolls, under twenty words each.

visual.title: Prompt in action
items: I run a small bakery. Write 3 friendly Instagram captions for our new cinnamon rolls, under 20 words each.
1. Fresh cinnamon rolls just landed, and they won't last long. 2. Warm, gooey, and worth every crumb. 3. Your morning coffee just found its best friend.

scenes.narration: One more pro tip. Tell Claude who to be. For example: act as a patient math tutor. It changes the style of every answer.
